Blot of grey smoke with a circular, lamprey-like mouth.

AC 15, HP 68, ATK 1 touch +10 (disintegrate) or possession, MV double near (fly), S -4, D +5, C +5, I +4, W +4, Ch +4, AL C, LV 14

Disintegrate. A target creature of LV 5 or less instantly dies. If it is LV 6+, it takes 3d8 damage instead.

Incorporeal. In place of attacks, become corporeal or incorporeal.

Possession. Must be corporeal. One target, close range. Contested CHA check. If Isph-Aun-Vuln wins, she inhabits target's body and controls it.

Pure Evil. Only damaged by cold iron or magical sources. Immune to cold.

Soul Barrier. When corporeal, surrounded by wind made of damned souls. Ranged attacks against Isph-Aun-Vuln have DISADV.
